name: Transaction Dispute Portal
description: A banking portal where customers dispute card and account transactions and follow each decision, while agents work a review queue to approve or reject them.
highlights: Clean Architecture and CQRS, with business rules in the domain
Role-based sign-in with Keycloak (OIDC and PKCE)
Concurrency control, so two agents cannot overwrite each other
Health checks, rate limiting and structured logging

name: Cash Operations
description: A full-stack app for capturing, editing and reviewing cash transactions.
highlights: Server-side paging, filtering and sorting with HotChocolate
Apollo Client with a typed, generated GraphQL schema

name: Account Management
description: A bank withdrawal endpoint rebuilt from a single controller method into a layered, event-publishing service.
highlights: An atomic database update prevents concurrent overdrafts
Publishes withdrawal events to AWS SNS

name: Elevator Challenge
description: A console simulation that moves passengers through a large building as efficiently as possible.
highlights: Assigns pickups by direction and passenger capacity
